records.title: CypherTurn: A Multi-Turn Benchmark for Conversational Text-to-Cypher Evaluation and the Autonomy Divergence
records.reason: CypherTurn is a conversational text-to-Cypher benchmark and evaluates multi-turn task accuracy; it proposes no inference-efficiency method.

records.title: SkillCome: Group Contrast Skill Optimization with Dual Memory
records.reason: SkillCome optimizes skill evolution with grouped trajectory comparisons and memory; it is a post-training capability method without a demonstrated inference resource reduction.

records.title: SkillGym: Training Skill-Use Agents with Automatic Verifiable Environment Generation
records.reason: SkillGym constructs training environments and trajectories for skill-use-agent fine-tuning; the efficiency target is absent and the contribution is training data/pipeline.

records.title: LongHarness Bench: Stress-Testing Language Model Harnesses for Long-Context Reasoning
records.reason: LongHarness Bench is an evaluation benchmark for long-context harness accuracy/cost tradeoffs; it does not propose or evaluate a new inference-efficiency system.

records.title: KlinikeBench: Evaluating Language Models Beyond Diagnostic Accuracy
records.reason: KlinikeBench evaluates clinical information gathering and diagnosis quality; it is not an LLM inference/serving efficiency contribution.
